item.title: SoCal drivers feeling pain at the pump amid war in Iran; gas prices up 50 cents from last week
item.description: The war with Iran has entered its second week, and gas prices are continuing to spike across Southern California.

item.title: Anthropic sues Trump administration seeking to undo 'supply chain risk' designation
item.description: San Francisco-based AI company Anthropic is suing the Trump administration, asking federal courts to reverse the Pentagon's decision designating it a "supply chain risk" over its refusal to allow unrestricted military use of its technology.

item.title: Remember this? Looking back at some of the most iconic, unexpected moments in Oscars history
item.description: Remember Ryan Gosling's unforgettable performance? Or when Jennifer Lawrence hilariously played off a fall on stage? Here are some of the Oscar moments we'll never forget.

item.title: Demi Weitz turns hardship into hope as she launches new music‑focused mission
item.description: For most of us, the pandemic meant loss, fear and uncertainty. But for a then-teenager in Los Angeles, it sparked something remarkable.

item.title: Grocery Outlet closing 36 stores, including several in SoCal
item.description: Grocery Outlet Bargain Market is closing 36 underperforming stores nationwide, including several locations in Southern California.

item.title: Rep. Swalwell rips ICE for deporting Hayward family; his office flew to Colombia to help deaf child
item.description: East Bay Rep. Eric Swalwell is calling for the return of a deported mother and her two children to the Bay Area. One of the kids is a deaf 6-year-old, and Swalwell says his office flew to Colombia to give him his hearing device.

item.title: ESPN's Stephen A. Smith honored with award by Broadcasters Foundation of America
item.description: Stephen A. Smith was presented with the first Broadcasters Foundation of America "Broadcast Personality of the Year Award" Monday night during a gala at the Plaza Hotel.

item.title: Uber, Lyft trips to and from LAX could cost you more. Here's what to know
item.description: LAX is considering raising its fees for ride-share drivers, a move officials say is aimed at reducing traffic in the airport's central terminal.

item.title: Orange County sheriff's deputy charged in shooting death of her fiancée in Tustin
item.description: An Orange County Sheriff's deputy has been charged in the shooting death of her fiancée in their Tustin apartment. She was off-duty at the time of the shooting.

item.title: JetBlue flights to resume after request for ground stop, FAA says
item.description: JetBlue flights will resume after a nationwide ground stop had been canceled, the FAA said in an advisory.
